a.note: The owner's SCHWA_D_AF_HEART handoff, built outside this repo: an af_heart schwa, 363 ms of speech, accepted as option D. Shipped as the bytes they graded on the listening page - the accepted body at 80/300 ms padding, turned down 4.8 dB to the level of the schwa already in the game, encoded at the pack's 96 kbps. No re-bake: the handoff's own recipe says Praat's overlap-add cannot be reproduced sample for sample, so the accepted WAV is the authority. The human reference recording in that package is an amplitude-envelope target only and is not in this repository.
